gaps: Clerk: only years (not days) for most clerks; no clerk listed for 1948-1949 between Yates and DeBeck.
Auditor General: 1917-1977 no holders (office lapsed); Comptroller-General not researched as a predecessor; no AG listed for 1878 (Berkeley to Jan 1878, Austin from Jan 1879).
Ombudsperson: pre-2015 holders only to the year; exact acting periods for Bazowski and Parfitt not found.
Information and Privacy Commissioner: exact day Flaherty/Loukidelis changed over in 1999, and McEvoy's end / Harvey's start day in 2024, not found.
Chief Electoral Officer: Craig James's acting start taken as 2010 (Neufeld's term ended 2010-06-05); no holder recorded for 1979-10 to 1980-04.
Police Complaint Commissioner: no holder found for 2002-05 to 2003-02; Pecknold's exact start/end days and Lowe's retirement day not confirmed from a primary source.

Representative for Children and Youth: no Child, Youth and Family Advocate found for 2001-2002; Children's Commissioners (Cynthia Morton first) and Child and Youth Officer dates not fully established.
Human rights: no chairs found for the Human Rights Commission (1973-1984) or the BC Council of Human Rights (1984-1997); Ruff's title is Director of the Human Rights Branch, not commissioner.
Merit Commissioner: 2001-2005 ex officio holders not all named (Diane Rabbani's start unknown); Joy Illington's end and Fiona Spencer's end dates not found.
Court of Appeal and Supreme Court chief justices before 2009/2013: years only (Wikipedia), no days; the Court of Appeal was established under the 1907 Act and sat from 1909/1910.
Provincial Court chief judges before 2018: years only.
Speaker: LLBC list updated Dec 2020; Chouhan's 2024 re-election day not recorded (held as one continuous record).
